sources.snippet: Typhoon Whisper Turbo Typhoon Whisper Turbo is a state-of-the-art Thai Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model fine-tuned on the OpenAI Whisper Large v3 Turbo architecture. It is engineered to deliver a balance of high accuracy and low latency for offline transcription, significantly outperforming standard Whisper models in throughput while maintaining robust performance on Thai speech.

sources.title: Typhoon - Thailand's Frontier AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: A Thai-script-based orthographic system designed to represent Isan words consistently and systematically. It provides clear rules for writing Isan in a way that supports linguistic research, dataset creation, and AI model training.
